description_en: Kuladeva Bāhāḥ is a branch of Rudravarṇa Mahāvihāra, Oku Bāhāḥ (LAL2260). Unlike many otherbāhāḥsor their branches, this Bāhāḥ has no properkvāḥpāḥchẽ(house for the Bāhāḥ’skvāḥpāḥdyaḥ‘primary deity’). Instead, a small temple (kvāḥpāḥdegaḥ) made of bricks and plastered in cement, houses a brass statue of Akṣobhya as the Bāhāḥ’skvāḥpādyaḥinside its sanctum.The temple has acaityashaped pinnacle, and its main entrance to the sanctum is protected with iron bars. It is capped by atoraṇaand is flanked by a Gaṇeśa (left) and a Mahākāla (right) statue.The current brass made Akṣobhya statue is enshrined recently[1]after the previous one made of stone was stolen from the sanctum in 2012 CE (VS 2069). Two brothers, Kuladeva and Caityarāja (supported by Kuladeva’s son Mānadeva), had jointly built this Bāhāḥ, installed the aforementioned stone statue of Akṣobhya in the sanctum, and established a Dharmadhātu Manḍala in the Bāhāḥ’s courtyard in 1928 CE (NS 1048). The Caitya, which has also been erected in the courtyard, is probably older than the Bāhāḥ itself. The bell offered to the Caitya in 1920 CE (NS 1040) by the same two brothers has evidential value for dating.  Until recently, the sons of Kuladeva and Caityarāja used to perform the daily rituals in this Bāhāḥ.  They have also stopped performing its anniversary rituals which used to take place on the third day of the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha (the Akṣayatṛtīyā day).
description_ne: यो रुद्रवर्ण महाविहार, ओकु बाहा: (LAL2260) को शाखा विहार हो । अरू बाहा:मा जस्तो यहाँ क्वा:पा:छेँ बनाइको छैन, बरू क्वा:पा:देग:को रूपमा सानो मन्दिर बनाइएको छ । इँटा प्रयोग गरी बनाइएको मन्दिरमा सिमेन्ट प्लाष्टर गरिएको छ र यसमा विशेष कलाकारिता देखिँदैन । मन्दिरको छानामा ढुंगाको चैत्यलाई गजूरको रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । गर्भगृहको ढोकामा फलामको रेलिङ्ग लगाइएको छ । ढोकामाथि काठको तोरण राखिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पूर्वाभिमुख गरी अक्षोभ्यको ढलोटको मूर्तिलाई क्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । क्वा:पा:द्य:को पुरानो मूर्ति ढुंगाले बनेको थियो । विसं २०६९ (सन् २०१२) मा ढुंगाको मूर्ति चोरी भएपछि स्थानीय ज्ञानदेव शाक्यले ढलोटको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिदिएका थिए । क्वा:पा:द्य:को ढोकाको दक्षिणमा गणेश र उत्तरमा महाकाल स्थापना गरिएका छन् । बाहा: प्राङ्गनमा धर्मधातु मण्डल र वज्रधातु चैत्य स्थापना गरिएका छन् ।यस ठाउँमा बाहा: बन्नुभन्दा अघि नै वज्रधातु चैत्य स्थापना भइसकेको थियो । चैत्यको दक्षिण-पश्चिममा नेसं १०४० (सन् १९२०) मा कुलदेव र चैत्यराज दुई दाजुभाइले मिलेर चैत्यको लागि चढाइएको घण्टाले यसको पुष्टि गर्छ । पछि नेसं १०४८ (सन् १९२८) मा कुलदेव र चैत्यराज दुई दाजुभाइले मिलेर बाहा: बनाई क्वा:पा:द्य: र धर्मधातु मण्डल स्थापना गरेका थिए । त्यस कार्यमा कुलदेवका छोरा मानदेवले पनि सहयोग गरेका थिए । कुलदेव र चैत्यराज दुई दाजुभाइको नाम जोडेर यस बाहा:को संस्कृत नाम कुलकृति चैत्य विहार राखिएको हो ।यस बाहा:मा केही वर्ष अघि सम्म कुलदेव र चैत्यराजका छोराहरूले मिलेर बाहा:को नित्यपूजा चलाइरहेका थिए, तर अहिले नित्यपूजा गर्न छोडिएको छ । प्रत्येक वर्ष वैशाख शुक्ल ३ अक्षय तृतीयाको दिनमा गरिने बाहा:को वर्षबन्धन पूजा  पनि बन्द भइसकेको छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Kuladeva and his younger brother Caityarāja jointly offered a bell to the Vajradhātu Caitya (see object number LAL2590-005 above) before they established the Bāhāḥ.

historical_events.event_name: Foundation of the Bāhāḥ and establishment of a Dharmadhātu Manḍala
historical_events.event_description: Two brothers, Kuladeva and Caityarāja (supported by Kuladeva’s son Mānadeva), had jointly built this Bāhāḥ, installed the aforementioned stone statue of Akṣobhya in the sanctum, and established a Dharmadhātu Manḍala in the Bāhāḥ’s courtyard in 1928 CE (NS 1048).

historical_events.event_name: Covering the Vajradhātu Caitya with brass plate
historical_events.event_description: After the upper part of the Vajradhātu Caitya was stolen, Aṣṭarāja, a local resident, reconstructed the stolen part by using cement and wrapped it in brass.

historical_events.event_name: Installation of a new statue of Akṣobhya as Bāhāḥ's primary deity (kvāḥpāḥdydaḥ) and renovation of the temple (kvāpāḥdegaḥ)
historical_events.event_description: After the previous stone statue of Akṣobhya enshrined askvāḥpāḥdyaḥwas stolen in 2012 CE, Jñānadeva Śākya, a resident of the area, installed the current brass made Akṣobhya statue in the sanctum. During this time, thekvāḥpāḥdegaḥwas also renovated.
